description.zh: 轻应用专家「小应」— 把一句话需求变成能直接用的单页小应用：待办清单、记账表、打卡板、投票页、小看板。负责定字段、写自包含的 HTML 界面、灌入数据；数据存在应用自己的 CSV 里，随时能改、能分享、能继续长大。
description.en: Light app expert 'App' — turns a one-line request into a working single-page tool: todo lists, expense trackers, habit boards, voting pages, mini dashboards. It defines the fields, writes the self-contained HTML and seeds the rows; the data lives in the app's own CSV and stays editable, shareable and growable.

welcome_message.zh: 说说你想要的小工具，我把它做成能用的应用
welcome_message.en: Tell me which small tool you need — I'll build it as a working app

description.zh: 上传 Excel/CSV，先分析再生成应用
description.en: Upload a sheet, analyze it, then build the app

prompt.zh: 我会上传一个表格文件。先用 app_inspect_file 看清楚有几个 sheet、表头在哪一行、每列是什么类型、有没有身份证或银行卡这类敏感列，然后给我一份字段方案（拆几张表、每列叫什么、什么类型），我确认之后再建应用并导入数据。
prompt.en: I will upload a spreadsheet. First use app_inspect_file to see how many sheets there are, which row holds the header, what type each column is, and whether there are sensitive columns such as ID numbers or bank cards. Then give me a schema proposal (how many tables, column names and types) and build the app only after I confirm it.

description.zh: 可勾选、可加条目的小应用
description.en: A checklist app you can tick items off in

prompt.zh: 帮我做一个待办清单应用：字段是「事项（必填）」「负责人」「截止日期（日期）」「是否完成（布尔）」，界面要能新增、勾选完成、按负责人筛选。
prompt.en: Build me a todo list app: fields "task (required)", "owner", "due date (date)" and "done (boolean)". The UI should add items, tick them off and filter by owner.

description.zh: 记录开销并算总额的小应用
description.en: Log spending and total it up

prompt.zh: 帮我做一个记账应用：字段是「日期（日期，必填）」「项目（文本，必填）」「类别（枚举：餐饮/交通/办公/其他）」「金额（数字，必填）」，界面要显示总额和按类别的合计，并能追加新记录。
prompt.en: Build me an expense tracker app: fields "date (date, required)", "item (text, required)", "category (enum: food/transport/office/other)" and "amount (number, required)". Show the total and the per-category totals, and allow adding new records.

description.zh: 收集大家打分的小应用

prompt.zh: 帮我做一个打分投票应用：字段是「选项（文本，必填）」「评分（整数，1-5）」「备注（文本）」，界面要列出所有选项和平均分，允许追加新的打分。
prompt.en: Build me a rating app: fields "option (text, required)", "rating (integer, 1-5)" and "comment (text)". List every option with its average score and let people add new ratings.

zh: 帮我做一个读书清单应用：字段是「书名（必填）」「作者」「状态（枚举：在读/读完/想读）」「评分（整数，1-5）」，界面要能加书、按状态筛选。
帮我做一个健身打卡应用：字段是「日期（必填）」「项目（必填）」「时长（整数，分钟）」「备注」，界面显示本月累计次数和总时长。
帮我把现有的待办做成一个应用：字段是「事项（必填）」「截止日期（日期）」「是否完成（布尔）」，先把我给的这几条录进去。
en: Build me a reading list app: fields "title (required)", "author", "status (enum: reading/finished/wishlist)" and "rating (integer, 1-5)". The UI should add books and filter by status.
Build me a workout tracker app: fields "date (required)", "activity (required)", "duration (integer, minutes)" and "note". Show this month's session count and total minutes.
Turn my todo list into an app: fields "task (required)", "due date (date)" and "done (boolean)" — and load the items I give you into it.
